scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,react -c yellow,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:research-sidecar: cd services/research-sidecar && PYTHONPATH=src RESEARCH_SIDECAR_ENV_FILE=../../.env.local CACHE_ROOT=data/current-graph-cache NEO4J_URI=neo4j://127.0.0.1:7687 NEO4J_USERNAME=neo4j NEO4J_PASSWORD=${NEO4J_PASSWORD:-research-sidecar-dev} .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn backend.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:with-research-sidecar: concurrently -n server,react,sidecar -c yellow,green,cyan "RESEARCH_NEW_ENGINE=sidecar npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:research-sidecar"
scripts.check:react: npm run typecheck --workspace @matthews-workspace/react && npm run test:client && npm run build
scripts.dev:with-bug-review-sidecar: concurrently -n server,react,bug-review -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:bug-review-sidecar"
